arxiv-2009-03705.title: Comparison of camera-based and 3D LiDAR-based loop closures across weather conditions
arxiv-2009-03705.creator: Kamil Żywanowski*, Adam Banaszczyk*, Michał R. Nowicki
arxiv-2009-03705.description: Abstract Loop closure based on camera images provides excellent results on benchmarking datasets, but might struggle in real-world adverse weather conditions like direct sun, rain, fog, or just darkness at night. In automotive applications, the sensory setups include 3D LiDARs that provide information complementary to cameras.

arxiv-2112-01001.title: SEAL: Self-supervised Embodied Active Learning using Exploration and 3D Consistency
arxiv-2112-01001.creator: Devendra Singh Chaplot, Murtaza Dalal, Saurabh Gupta, Jitendra Malik, Ruslan Salakhutdinov
arxiv-2112-01001.description: Abstract In this paper, we explore how we can build upon the data and models of Internet images and use them to adapt to robot vision without requiring any extra labels. We present a framework called Self-supervised Embodied Active Learning (SEAL). It utilizes perception models trained on internet images to learn an active exploration policy.

arxiv-2112-08495.title: A Targeted Approach to Confounder Selection for High-Dimensional Data
arxiv-2112-08495.creator: Asad Haris, Robert Platt
arxiv-2112-08495.description: Abstract We consider the problem of selecting confounders for adjustment from a potentially large set of covariates, when estimating a causal effect. Recently, the high-dimensional Propensity Score (hdPS) method was developed for this task; hdPS ranks potential confounders by estimating an importance score for each variable and selects the top few variables.

arxiv-2202-11967.title: Coherence of ion cyclotron resonance for damping ion cyclotron waves in space plasmas Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2202-11967.creator: Qiaowen Luo, Xingyu Zhu, Jiansen He, Jun Cui, Hairong Lai, Daniel Verscharen, Die Duan
arxiv-2202-11967.description: Abstract Ion cyclotron resonance is one of the fundamental energy conversion processes through field-particle interaction in collisionless plasmas. However, the key evidence for ion cyclotron resonance (i.e., the coherence between electromagnetic fields and the ion phase space density) and the resulting damping of ion cyclotron waves (ICWs) has not yet been directly observed.

arxiv-2203-12866.title: COSE ν \nu : A Collective Oscillation Simulation Engine for Neutrinos Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2203-12866.creator: Manu George, Chun-Yu Lin, Meng-Ru Wu, Tony G. Liu, Zewei Xiong
arxiv-2203-12866.description: Abstract We introduce the implementation details of the simulation code COSE ν \nu , which numerically solves a set of non-linear partial differential equations that govern the dynamics of neutrino collective flavor conversions. We systematically provide the details of both finite difference method supported by Kreiss-Oliger dissipation and finite volume method with seventh order weighted essentially non-oscillatory scheme.

arxiv-2210-01453.title: Massive stars in metal-poor dwarf galaxies are often extreme rotators Volume: 361 Journal: Massive Stars Near and Far
arxiv-2210-01453.creator: Abel Schootemeijer 1, Danny J. Lennon 2,3, Miriam Garcia 4, Norbert Langer 1,5, Ben Hastings 1,5, Christoph Schürmann 1,5
arxiv-2210-01453.description: Abstract We probe how common extremely rapid rotation is among massive stars in the early universe by measuring the OBe star fraction in nearby metal-poor dwarf galaxies. We apply a new method that uses broad-band photometry to measure the galaxy-wide OBe star fractions in the Magellanic Clouds and three more distant, more metal-poor dwarf galaxies.

arxiv-2412-07921.title: Electron–Ion Coupling Breaks Energy Symmetry in Organic Electrochemical Transistors
arxiv-2412-07921.creator: Lukas M. Bongartz, Garrett LeCroy, Tyler J. Quill, Nicholas Siemons, Gerwin Dijk, Adam Marks, Christina Cheng, Hans Kleemann, Karl Leo, Alberto Salleo
arxiv-2412-07921.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Lukas M. Bongartz, Garrett LeCroy, Tyler J. Quill, Nicholas Siemons, Gerwin Dijk, Adam Marks, Christina Cheng, Hans Kleemann, Karl Leo, Alberto Salleo. Organic electrochemical transistors are extensively studied for applications ranging from bioelectronics to analog and neuromorphic computing. Despite significant advances, the fundamental interactions between the polymer semiconductor channel and the electrolyte, which critically determine the device performance, remain underexplored. Here, we examine the coupling between the benchmark semiconductor PEDOT:PSS and ionic liquids to explain the bistable and non-volatile behavior observed in OECTs.

arxiv-2412-17137.title: The Role of Integration Cycles in Complex Langevin Simulations
arxiv-2412-17137.creator: Michael W. Hansen, Michael Mandl, Erhard Seiler, Dénes Sexty
arxiv-2412-17137.description: Abstract Complex Langevin simulations are an attempt to solve the sign (or complex-action) problem encountered in various physical systems of interest. The method is based on a complexification of the underlying degrees of freedom and an evolution in an auxiliary time dimension.

europmc-pmc9725182.creator: Cox CM, Thoma ME, Tchangalova N, Mburu G, Bornstein MJ, Johnson CL, Kiarie J.

pmc-10666156.title: Relativistic DFT Calculations of Cadmium and Selenium Solid-State NMR Spectra of CdSe Nanocrystal Surfaces
pmc-10666156.creator: Rana Biswas, Yunhua Chen, Javier Vela, Aaron J. Rossini
pmc-10666156.description: Solid-state NMR spectra have been used to probe the structure of CdSe nanocrystals and propose detailed models of their surface structures. Density functional theory (DFT)-optimized cluster models that represent probable molecular structures of carboxylate-coordinated surface sites have been proposed. However, to the best of our knowledge, 113Cd and 77Se chemical shifts have not been calculated for these surface models.

pmc-11601899.title: Therapeutic hypoxia for mitochondrial disease via enhancement of hemoglobin affinity and inhibition of HIF-2α
pmc-11601899.creator: Hong Wang, Maria Miranda, Eizo Marutani, Paul Lichtenegger, Gregory R. Wojtkiewicz, Fumito Ichinose, Vamsi K. Mootha
pmc-11601899.description: oxygen can prevent and reverse neurological disease, while 55% oxygen accelerates disease (1–3). Multiple mechanisms likely underlie the benefits of hypoxia, including attenuation of oxygen toxicity from brain hyperoxia, restoration of Fe-S clusters, and normalization of oxygen sensing. Alternative means of reducing oxygen delivery, including sublethal carbon monoxide and severe anemia, also reverse brain disease in Ndufs4-KO mice (4).

pmc-12451068.title: The Combined Effect of Visual Stimulus Complexity and Semantic Content on Audiovisual Associative Equivalence Learning
pmc-12451068.creator: Kálmán Tót, Noémi Harcsa‐Pintér, Adél Papp, Balázs Bodosi, Attila Nagy, Gabriella Eördegh
pmc-12451068.description: BackgroundThe Rutgers Acquired Equivalence Test (RAET) is an associative learning task that requires participants to learn pairs of visual stimuli and then recall and generalize these associations. To further explore this cognitive task, we developed three audiovisual learning tests with the same structure as the original RAET.

pmc-12569525.title: Factors Associated With the Risk of Neuropathic Pain One Year After Total Knee Arthroplasty and the Protective Role of Local Infiltration Analgesia: A Registry‐Based Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-12569525.creator: Hermes H. Miozzari, Alice Bonnefoy‐Mazure, Nicolas Silvestrini, Christophe Barea, Didier Hannouche, Anne Lübbeke
pmc-12569525.description: ObjectiveTo identify predictors of reduced risk for neuropathic pain (NP) one year after total knee arthroplasty (TKA) among patients who did not report NP before surgery.MethodsWe included primary TKAs performed between January 1, 2014, and June 30, 2022. NP was defined as Douleur Neuropathique en 4 Questions scores ≥4 before and one year after TKA.

pmc-12572183.title: Chaos theory modeling improves olecranodiaphyseal angle prediction from proximal ulnar dorsal angulation in healthy elbows
pmc-12572183.creator: Abdulhamit Misir, Cafer Ozgur Hancerli
pmc-12572183.description: To evaluate the relationship between Proximal Ulnar Dorsal Angulation (PUDA) and Olecranodiaphyseal Angle (ODA) in healthy elbows using both linear regression and advanced chaos theory approaches, analyzing the effects of age, sex, and side parameters. In this cross-sectional study, 295 healthy elbows (178 male, 117 female; 130 right, 165 left) were evaluated with standard radiographs.

pmc-12596264.title: Lessons learned from physician-performed high-resolution esophageal manometries
pmc-12596264.creator: Nicha Wongjarupong, Ali Rezaie, Mark Pimentel, Bianca W Chang, Yin Chan, Jane E Lim, Alice C Huang, Amrit K Kamboj
pmc-12596264.description: SummaryHigh-resolution esophageal manometry (HRM) is the gold standard test for evaluation and diagnosis of esophageal motility disorders. While the Chicago Classification offers a standardized protocol for performing and interpreting HRM studies, it does not provide guidance on catheter placement techniques, nor the specific skillset required to conduct the test.

pmc-13003219.title: Extracellular vesicles modulate skin aging biomarkers in a 3D reconstructed full-thickness skin model
pmc-13003219.creator: Yao Teng, Elias Bou Samra, Sarah Girardeau-Hubert, Richard J. Betts, Franck Juchaux, Xavier Marat, Benedicte Fallou, Lingyan Zhong, Rodrigo De Vecchi, Nan Huang, Qian Zheng, Yu Gao, Daniel C. Roy, Ping Wang
pmc-13003219.description: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are lipid-enveloped nanovesicles rich in microRNAs, proteins and lipids, that serve as potent mediators of intercellular communication. While EVs have demonstrated pro-regenerative potential in 2D and preclinical models, their impact on skin regeneration and aging processes in 3D reconstructed skin models has remained less explored.
